intent_contract.text: 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉

Requester asks for independent randomized complex photographic horror qualification using the supplied image. Horror is the topic context supplied by the coordinator, not a new user definition. Arm A independently chooses an everyday salvage task in a leaking self-storage office: the woman has lifted vulnerable family photographs toward an exit whose shutter is closing, then notices that her mirror image performs a different bodily action and holds an undamaged closed carton. The viewer first recognizes the careful practical grip and vulnerable material, then sees the mirrored palm pressing the glass and reinterprets the interrupted task as a threat. These setting, motive, gesture, carton states and reflection mechanic are agent-owned staging. Face and hair reference appearance remains assessable, with subtle attraction carried by luminous eyes and soft lips rather than changing her features. Saved sensual=1, fetish=0, creativity=1 and surreal=0 are retained; the single anomalous reflection realizes the assigned horror-family experiment and no additional unrelated surreal treatment is introduced.

An everyday uncanny horror photograph of a woman guided by the supplied portrait, caught in an unnerving interruption of a practical task. The subject is a fictional adult woman; her facial appearance and hair follow the attached portrait: a chin-length dark brown bob with wispy parted bangs, large dark brown eyes, softly rounded cheeks, a short straight nose and naturally glossy rose lips. She is inside an upper-floor self-storage office during a rainstorm, trying to rescue a carton of household photographs before a half-lowered metal roller shutter shuts the exit. A ceiling leak has soaked one corner of the carton and left a narrow glistening stream across the concrete floor; a rubber wedge lies just inside the shutter gap. She supports the soaked open cardboard carton at waist height with both hands beneath its base, elbows bent close to her ribs. Her feet are planted on the dry strip beside the water. A transparent sleeve of small household photographs protrudes between the spread flaps, and she has turned her face toward a tall framed mirror leaning against the wall immediately beside her. Her lips have just parted and her shoulders hold the arrested weight of the box. Inside the mirror, the same face and bob are clearly recognizable, but her reflected right palm is pressed flat against the inner glass with five separated fingers, while her reflected left arm cradles a dry, neatly closed version of the carton. The real woman's two hands remain plainly visible beneath the open box. The mirrored palm and changed carton belong to her reflected body; the continuous metal frame makes the glass boundary unmistakable. A clean palm-shaped patch interrupts light condensation on that glass. The ordinary room lines, shutter and lamp still align across the reflection. A cool overhead LED shapes her eyes, cheek and fingertips, while amber corridor light enters under the shutter and grazes the wet floor. She wears a soft navy knit shirt beneath a practical faded canvas jacket. Frame her real face, supported carton, reflected face and palm as the connected center of attention, with the threatened exit behind them. An eye-level three-quarter camera view, a natural 50mm perspective, a medium view from head to mid-thigh and enough depth of field to read both faces keep this intimate discovery assessable. Real skin texture, softened shirt creases, saturated cardboard fibers, transparent sleeve edges and restrained low-light grain make the impossible reflection sit inside a materially credible photograph.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Effective sensual=1, fetish=0; the higher intensity leads.

authorial_core.interpreted_intent: Requester asks for independent randomized complex photographic horror qualification using the supplied image. Horror is the topic context supplied by the coordinator, not a new user definition. Arm A independently chooses an everyday salvage task in a leaking self-storage office: the woman has lifted vulnerable family photographs toward an exit whose shutter is closing, then notices that her mirror image performs a different bodily action and holds an undamaged closed carton. The viewer first recognizes the careful practical grip and vulnerable material, then sees the mirrored palm pressing the glass and reinterprets the interrupted task as a threat. These setting, motive, gesture, carton states and reflection mechanic are agent-owned staging. Face and hair reference appearance remains assessable, with subtle attraction carried by luminous eyes and soft lips rather than changing her features. Saved sensual=1, fetish=0, creativity=1 and surreal=0 are retained; the single anomalous reflection realizes the assigned horror-family experiment and no additional unrelated surreal treatment is introduced.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: An everyday uncanny horror photograph of a woman guided by the supplied portrait, caught in an unnerving interruption of a practical task. The subject is a fictional adult woman; her facial appearance and hair follow the attached portrait: a chin-length dark brown bob with wispy parted bangs, large dark brown eyes, softly rounded cheeks, a short straight nose and naturally glossy rose lips. She is inside an upper-floor self-storage office during a rainstorm, trying to rescue a carton of household photographs before a half-lowered metal roller shutter shuts the exit. A ceiling leak has soaked one corner of the carton and left a narrow glistening stream across the concrete floor; a rubber wedge lies just inside the shutter gap. She supports the soaked open cardboard carton at waist height with both hands beneath its base, elbows bent close to her ribs. Her feet are planted on the dry strip beside the water. A transparent sleeve of small household photographs protrudes between the spread flaps, and she has turned her face toward a tall framed mirror leaning against the wall immediately beside her. Her lips have just parted and her shoulders hold the arrested weight of the box. Inside the mirror, the same face and bob are clearly recognizable, but her reflected right palm is pressed flat against the inner glass with five separated fingers, while her reflected left arm cradles a dry, neatly closed version of the carton. The real woman's two hands remain plainly visible beneath the open box. The mirrored palm and changed carton belong to her reflected body; the continuous metal frame makes the glass boundary unmistakable. A clean palm-shaped patch interrupts light condensation on that glass. The ordinary room lines, shutter and lamp still align across the reflection. A cool overhead LED shapes her eyes, cheek and fingertips, while amber corridor light enters under the shutter and grazes the wet floor. She wears a soft navy knit shirt beneath a practical faded canvas jacket. Frame her real face, supported carton, reflected face and palm as the connected center of attention, with the threatened exit behind them. An eye-level three-quarter camera view, a natural 50mm perspective, a medium view from head to mid-thigh and enough depth of field to read both faces keep this intimate discovery assessable. Real skin texture, softened shirt creases, saturated cardboard fibers, transparent sleeve edges and restrained low-light grain make the impossible reflection sit inside a materially credible photograph.
